scope: Repaired-reader metadata acceptance only; no video downloads, scene viability or privacy-accuracy claim. Camera rec_timestamp default; main GNSS sensor timestamp retained; untimed quality-flagged messages preserve source-order gaps.
report_annotation: Reader-policy description corrected after worker completion; check results and input identities unchanged; original worker report retained locally.
reader_policy: All recordings: camera rec_time_offset_ns; main gnss time_offset_ns; preserve consistent origin and null invalid diagnostics; untimed quality-flagged source-order gaps excluded; no logger substitution

memory.scope: audit worker, supervisor and descendants; excludes the Codex app and other tasks; RSS monitoring is not an OS-enforced app-wide memory limit
